contexts.text: The fountain of life () = the Celestial which is of love.
Falsities spring from cupidities, etc. AE 776.
That which does not spring or flow forth from interior evil...
All truths of faith spring from good.
Diseases spring from unclean things.
Hence is the spring of many evils.
Such falsities as spring from evil... The evil from which these falsities spring...
The springs of waters () = the Knowledges of truth from the Word.
All evil springs principally from the love of self. HH 555:end.
All evils spring from the loves of self and of the world. HH 570.
Their interiors which abound in falsities and evils.
Evil affections which spring from the will.
The spring of these delights is the love of dominating from the love of self. DP 215:9.
To make the fountain of Babylon dry () = to extinguish all the truth of that Church from its primes.
Falsities of concupiscences which spring from evil loves. Signified, Explained.
Hence the spring of conjugial love is closed.
The spring of manliness can be kept closed and reserved for a wife with few.
When evils spring from their native fountain.
I will make the dry land a spring of waters ()... = good, because truth. ( = to infill with truths the natural man. AE 730:24.)
Upon the springs of waters shall He lead them ()... = enlightenment in all truth. A spring, or fountain, is the Word, and also doctrine from it.
His fountain = the doctrine of what is false; his spring () = its falsity. (Spring = doctrine; and fountain = the Word. AE 730:12.)
The Sensuous is the spring of all evils and the derivative falsities.
A thirsty place shall become springs of waters () = the truths which they shall have.
This love (of commanding) is the spring of all evils.
